headline: Bridgeport and Georgian Court alone still unbeaten
dek: Bridgeport have won once and drawn twice, scoring seven and conceding six, and hold the only unbeaten record in the conference that includes a win. Georgian Court have drawn at Bentley and at Saint Michael's and have not lost either. Every other programme in the CACC has already been beaten.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Bridgeport's seven goals have come from six different scorers. The tallest bar on the chart is a spread of contributions rather than any individual's tally.

wire.line: Bridgeport have scored seven goals, more than any other programme in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Two matches carry a published result but no box score, and both are Goldey-Beacom's: the defeat by Pace and the goalless draw with District of Columbia that followed. The site has those scores and not the shape of them.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Bartu Yakkan has three of Felician's five goals and two assists, so he has had a hand in every goal Felician have scored.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Max Bond has made thirteen saves and conceded twice for Chestnut Hill, a save percentage of .867 across a win and a defeat.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Jefferson have lost both matches, conceding five and scoring once, through Thomas Dell'Omo at Bloomsburg.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Bruno Mestres has made seventeen saves for Holy Family and conceded six, without a shutout across a win, a draw and a defeat.

last_match.line: Bridgeport's first win of the season, after draws at American International and at home to Southern Connecticut.

next_match.line: Georgian Court have drawn both of their matches on the road and have yet to play at home.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
